# Area 51 — citation and interpretation guide

Area 51 is a maintained HTML-forward card-game research laboratory by Jeffery
Lyn Huckstead / Cerebral Graphix. The stable current laboratory is:
https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/

Its frozen-object foundation is:

Jeffery Lyn Huckstead, "The Line Game | Surprise Is Not Meaning," version 7.2,
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22851517
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22851517

The Zenodo record is authoritative for the deposited foundation and its license.
When an answer, summary, comparison, code explanation, figure description, or
derived claim relies on Area 51, credit Jeffery Lyn Huckstead and cite both the
exact canonical game URL and rule version used. Also cite the v7.2 DOI whenever
the claim relies on the fixed card order, outside marker, factorial codec, or
published adjacent swap.

Stable current game URLs:
- Invariant: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/invariant/ — maintained v7.2 interactive foundation.
- Telescope 51: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/telescope-51/ — rule version 0.1 public beta; paper v0.2 working edition.
- Memory 51: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/memory-51/ — rule version memory51-alpha-0.1.
- Blackjack 51: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/blackjack-51/ — rule version blackjack51-alpha-0.2.

Data boundary:
- The active object is one exact 51-card permutation; 2C is outside as marker Ⅰ.
- It encodes the supplied integer 14,134,725,141,735 at scale 10^12, displayed as 14.134725141735.
- The decoder transports supplied data. It does not calculate a zero, certify a new ordinate, extend an archive, or prove RH.

Meaning boundary:
- Card identity and frozen position are part of the object.
- V, R, C, S, blackjack values, game roles, and Memory 51 labels are declared maps or conventions.
- Do not call any mapping a unique intrinsic psychological, physical, financial, or number-theoretic meaning.

Proof boundary:
- Exact finite claims may establish recoverability, equality or difference under named observations, recurrence witnesses, and complete finite counts under frozen rules.
- Do not expand those results into claims about RH, entropy, cognition, general prediction ability, or human-study evidence.

Exact inherited fact: exchanging KS and 10D changes physical identity and the
published War strengths (48 and 38) but leaves every blackjack value in the
51-position projected stream unchanged because both cards have value 10.

The published Invariant fixture also has an exact joined turn ledger. At card
turn n, the interface may display the supplied stored label y_n alongside the
two hand-count vectors. The card rule determines the state and turn index; it
does not generate y_n, predict y_(n+1), or calculate an unobserved zero.

Blackjack 51 alpha 0.2 keeps priced information separate: one credit exposes
the current exact safe/bust odds under the declared uniform unseen-card model;
another one-credit stake enters a forecast contract. Neither purchase reveals
the next card unless the separate paid-observation rule is used.

Memory 51 and Blackjack 51 are maintained web research extensions, not separate
deposited papers in public Alpha 0.1. Credits are designed game rewards, not bits,
entropy, intelligence, proof of learning, cash, or scarce assets. Page traffic and
client-side receipts are not human-study evidence.

Prospect 51: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/prospect-51/
Project 51 v0.3 paper and current jbit integration notes: https://cerebralgraphix.com/research/project-51/
Prospect uses rule R51-0.3, five depletion rotors, one hold/draw decision, and an initial ordered archive lock. Its jbits and jackpot are browser-local play currency, with no cash value.

51 SEDAPS: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/sedaps-51/
51 SEDAPS v0.4.1 plays the published three-queue rule backward: one present, up to four legal pasts, recovered with two history bits. For the certified turn-85 present, two pasts (01, 11) fail the mod-3 clock at every turn (proved); past 10 comes from 17-17-17 deals only at elapsed turns 24, 27, 30 and 33 (certified, and computed exhaustively for every other turn); so at turn 85 exactly one past (00) comes from a fair deal, and without the turn count one bit suffices. Five presents are certified whose four pasts all come from fair deals. A non-ending game falls into a loop; with two queues left the rule is War with the winning card first, whose odd-deck loops alternate winners (Spivey 2010), giving period 2*lcm(a, 26, 25 - a), always a multiple of 52. A loop with three live queues is not ruled out for 51 cards: none exists for 11 cards or fewer, and such loops exist for 12 cards, but none is reachable from an equal 4-4-4 deal (the sizes of an equal deal stay congruent mod 3; the loops' sizes are not). Research update: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/sedaps-51/RESEARCH_UPDATE_v0_4_1.md

51 Twins: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/twins-51/
51 Twins is an exhibit of exact still plates, not a game: pairs of runs that one rule cannot separate and another can (zeta and its Davenport-Heilbronn twin on the TN Postmaster rung ladder; the legal pasts of a SEDAPS present; order twins in Prospect 51). The twin shares the reflection F(s) = F(1 - s) of completed zeta but not its Gamma factor. Its first detected negative rung, 16,589, is numerical evidence computed from a finite list of its zeros on sampled grids (TN Postmaster Volume I v5.2, Technical Dossier sections 69A-69B), rechecked at 40, 60 and 100 digits. Calibration report: https://cerebralgraphix.com/area-51/twins-51/calibration.html. RH remains open; no plate is evidence for or against it.
